fences.rule: If the thing existed, was retained, and was then lost, the erasure is here; if what shapes the episode is an alternative that was represented or prepared for and never occurred, it is there, and the two maps are read against each other, not merged.
fences.case: A rampart raised against an invasion that never came and that still fixes where the town's streets run.

fences.rule: If a retained thing goes on steering behaviour after its function is gone, it is there as retention without function; only where the loss itself produces a capacity that retention was blocking is it here.
fences.case: A player who never forgets one accidental defection and stays locked in punishment long after the punishment deters nothing.

fences.rule: If the information survives the transformation and an echo can call it back, what the case exhibits is a preserved structure and it is there; the erasure is a carrier here only once the correlations have passed beyond any echo, which is why Thermal amnesia's survivor, the conserved quantities, belongs there and its loss of access belongs here.
fences.case: Spins dephasing in a gradient decay to one clean time constant, and a single pi pulse brings the whole signal back.
